registration_phase: before any solver/oracle warmup or timed call

rules.state_model: integer fees/values; formal utility U=scoreA-scoreB, exactly unchanged at cutoff; one action per depth
rules.generation: 18 new distinct maps, 3 families x 2 seeds x 4/6/8 treasures, structural connectivity only; depths equal treasure count
rules.four_treasures: designated no-nonterminal-reuse negative control; official H2/H4 separately checked outside timing
rules.key: fullscore stores absolute F and includes both scoreA and scoreB; incremental omits both and stores F-U; both contain exact depth, turn, both positions, mask
rules.terminal: terminal U returned directly before cache lookup; no terminal entries stored in any cache mode
rules.bounds: exact/lower/upper; relative value plus current U before bound comparison; unusable bounds continue with original window, no narrowing
rules.cache_lifetime: new table inside every top-level call; no cross-map/cross-method/cross-call reuse
rules.primary: incremental_ab vs fullscore_ab and none_ab, same kernel/order/map; original_ab is practical baseline
rules.game_time: precomputed verified matrix outside timer; includes validation, table construction/probes, search, sorting, and PV
rules.end_to_end: single full interval includes fresh (n+2)(n+1) ordered A* calls for complete matrix plus game result/PV; no symmetry shortcut
rules.oracle: independent Dijkstra all distances, complete nonmemoized enumeration all root actions, independent PV ledger; outside timing
rules.warmup: one game and end_to_end call per variant/order/input, discarded
rules.timing: 7 single-call blocks by default, seeded shuffle configurations and phase order, serial; default interpreter GC
rules.statistical_unit: 18 independent map/point/value inputs; blocks are timing repeats, not new inputs; retain every loss and count
rules.inference: structural repeated states do not prove AB visits or elapsed speedup; full paths and full matrices have same output contract
